title: Insurance handoff delay
accepted_explanation: The service team needs more staff.
observations: Cases move through multiple functional handoffs.
Exception approvals require escalation to managers.
Missing information produces rework and additional queue time.
Departments meet productivity targets while end-to-end cycle time remains high.
participant_claims: Managers cite workload and staffing shortage.
Employees describe unclear authority for exception decisions.
researcher_interpretations: Accumulated handoff and approval time may exceed touch-time delay.
assumptions: Demand growth is sufficient to explain delay.
